sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 7035 of 2024
Petitioner :- Farhan Ali Ad Another

Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Sectt. Lko And Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Mohammad Irfan Siddiqui

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Attau Rahman Masoodi,J.
Hon'ble Ajai Kumar Srivastava-I,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.G.A. for the State/respondent.
2.

The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioners with the following main relief:-
"(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari quashing the impugned first information report dated 10.07.2024, F.I.R. No.0296 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C., Sections 3/4 D.P. Act and Sections 3/4 Muslim Women (Protection of Right On Marriage) Act, 2019, Police Station Mohanlalganj, District Lucknow."

entities.text: Muslim Women (Protection of Right On Marriage) Act, 2019

1 authorities to follow the mandate of Section 35(3) of B.N.S.S., corresponding Section 41A Cr.P.C.,
for the reason that the offences mentioned in the impugned First Information Report carry the sentence of upto 7 years of imprisonment.

reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273.
